name: manao
description: A personal hub for turning thoughts, tasks, and information into clarity and purposeful action.

scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p dashboard/tsconfig.json && tsc -p dashboard/sw/tsconfig.json
scripts.check: bun run typecheck && bun run lint:claude && bun run test
scripts.dev: bun run build && d=$(mktemp -d) && echo "manao dev store: $d" && echo '{"api":{"port":0}}' > $d/config.json && MANAO_DB=$d/hub.db MANAO_CONFIG=$d/config.json node dist/cli.js run
